app.title: Digital Footprint Counter
dashboard.empty: Nothing yet. Browse a little and the leaf will start to move.
options.title: Settings
options.advanced_hint: Leave empty to use the region's documented values (shown as placeholder).
options.threshold_hint: Default thresholds are an adjustable reference (about 150 and 400 Wh per day), not a scientific standard.
options.delete_confirm: Delete all stored statistics? This cannot be undone.
eq.light_hours_co2: CO₂e of an LED bulb lit for {v}
reliability.def.high: High: specific technical data and coefficients are available.
reliability.def.medium: Medium: partial data and documented average coefficients.
reliability.def.low: Low: estimate based on generic parameters or assumptions.
reliability.def.unavailable: N/A: no sufficiently reliable estimate is possible.
m.license: Open source (MIT). Data and formulas are in the project's data folder.
welcome.title: Your browsing has a footprint.
welcome.lead: See it, understand it, reduce it. Estimated privately, on your device.
welcome.step1.title: Pin the leaf
welcome.step1.body: Extensions menu (puzzle icon), then pin. Your day at a glance.
welcome.step2.title: Choose your region
welcome.step2.body: Sets electricity mix and price. Change it anytime.
welcome.step3.title: Just browse
welcome.step3.body: The leaf turns green, yellow or red. Click it for the dashboard.
welcome.privacy: Only domains, counts, bytes and time are kept, on this device. Never content, addresses or prompts.
dash.trend_hint: Dashed lines mark the yellow and red thresholds.
hero.unsized: {n} of {total} requests without a declared size (bytes unavailable)
m.lead: Estimates, not measurements. This is how every number is made.
card.see.title: What we see
card.see.body: The website domain, the number of requests, their size when the server declares it, and your active time. If you turn on AI usage for a service, also how many messages you send to it (a number, never the content). Nothing else.
card.sure.title: How sure we are
card.sure.body: Every value is a range. Each estimate carries a reliability level:
card.cant.title: What we can't know
cant.1: What remote servers really consume for each request.
cant.2: Whether an AI request is a chat message or an image.
cant.3: AI video: no reliable data yet.
hero.incomplete: * Includes activities whose remote energy cannot be estimated yet (AI images and video).
options.private_note: Private windows are never tracked. Nothing leaves this device.
options.pause_hint: Nothing is recorded while paused. The leaf turns grey.
options.excluded_hint: One domain per line, for example mybank.com. Subdomains are included. Data already collected for a site you add is deleted.
options.summary: {days} days · {domains} sites · {size} stored on this device
pause.banner: Tracking is paused. Nothing is being recorded.
options.ai_hint: Counts how many messages you send to a service, to replace the assumed rate with real numbers. Only the number is kept, never what you write. Off by default, one choice per service. Service addresses change, so counting may stop working until the extension is updated.
options.ai_diag_running: Listening for 60 s. Use {service} now (send a message), then wait for the result.
options.ai_diag_done: {n} sending request(s) seen. A tick means the current rule counts it.
options.ai_diag_none: No sending request seen. Try again and send a message.
options.ai_diag_note: For one minute only, for this service only: method, address without parameters (identifiers hidden) and status. Nothing is stored and no content is read.
brk.unsized: Plus {n} requests without a declared size, estimated with an average size.
brk.unattr: Plus {n} requests ({size} declared) from background workers, not attributable to a tab and not counted.
dash.unattr: Requests from background workers of open sites, not attributable to a tab and not included in the estimate: {n} ({size} declared).
status.away: Away: no input for 5 minutes or screen locked
status.nosite: No website in the active tab
